source: lz-live probe --plan-only of tests/live/probes/alerting in the owner clone at the reviewed commit (the coordinator's confirming run after T065); the run record .local/live/<run id>/leftovers.json and listings/*.json, written through the run's redactor; plan only, nothing created, cost 0. Replaces the T065 capture of run 20261007T125154Z-14a6 (whose region details were derived, not captured). Committed by T087.

anonymised.method: ~/.local/share/ovh-lz/review/t065-anonymise.py <run dir> <this dir>: every UUID, 32-hex id (also inside the Swift endpoints' AUTH_<project id>), account handle (<letters><digits>-ovh) and e-mail replaced by a fixed fake value, the same original always by the same fake; the redactor's [REDACTED] marker becomes the fake client id; structure, field names, types and value shapes kept; the script fails before writing if an original value survives

values.what: public cloud project id (32 hex), also inside its URN, the listing paths of leftovers.json and the AUTH_<project id> suffix of the Swift storage and volume endpoints in the region details
account handle (policy owner, account resource URN, identity URNs)
id of the lz-sandbox-admin IAM policy (the admin exemption's policy id)
id of the ovh-default IAM policy
resource group id in the ovh-default policy
lz-sandbox-admin OAuth2 client id, already [REDACTED] by the run's redactor (clientId and the oauth2-<client id> identity URN; believed the same value)

anonymised.kept: resource names (lz-sandbox-admin, ovh-default, ADMIN, DEFAULT, UNPRIVILEGED: names the project or OVHcloud chose, no personal data), descriptions, actions, timestamps; region names, types, statuses, service names and the public OVHcloud service endpoint host names of the region details (the same for every project); no e-mail occurs in the committed files (the run's plan, which holds one, is not committed)

ovh_cloud_project_storage.note: []: the ten regions with a storage-s3-standard or storage-s3-high-perf service answered a bucket listing (any other answer was an error under the rule of the reviewed commit, and the only error is RBX-ARCHIVE's 404), all empty

ovh_cloud_project_user_s3_credential.note: child of a user; none exists; owed from T010

ovh_cloud_project_user_s3_policy.note: child of a user; none exists; owed from T010

ovh_me_api_oauth2_client.note: one client, the admin; the record holds clientId and name only (what the parser reads)

ovh_me_identity_group.note: three default groups; the record holds name only

ovh_iam_resource_tags.note: [{}]: the untagged project's IAM resource (no or null tags field, recorded as no tags since T065); a tagged answer is owed from T010

ovh_cloud_project_alerting.note: the id list was empty (no file, no error), so no alert was asked; owed from T010

ovh_cloud_quota.note: a property of the project, nothing to list

ovh_cloud_project.note: the adopted project, exempt by id

replay._note: Answers the run asked for. The region details (listings/ovh_cloud_project_region.json, captured, not a matrix kind) are served by the test as the region id list in recorded order plus one detail answer per element, as are the OAuth2 client and identity group records (TestLeftoversCaptured). Every entry below gives its provenance; an entry with from is the captured listing file served as one page. A route not named here answers 404 (the fake API's default): the seven compute regions' bucket listings (BHS5, DE1, GRA11, RBX-A, SBG5, UK1, WAW1; derived: no error under the reviewed commit's rule, which accepts their 404, and they answered 404 in run 20261007T125154Z-14a6) and RBX-ARCHIVE's (captured: leftovers.json).

/cloud/project/{p}/region/BHS/storage.provenance: derived: a storage-s3 region without an error, so its listing succeeded; the storage record is [], so it was empty

/cloud/project/{p}/region/CA-EAST-TOR/st.provenance: as BHS (region status DOWN, listing answered)

/cloud/project/{p}/alerting.provenance: derived: no alerting record and no alerting error, so the id list parsed and was empty
